title: 真实OpenSSH配置验收：本地转发只监听loopback并保持其他别名
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
body:
## 操作任务
实现configure(path,listen_port,dest_port)，修改夹具提供的独立SSH配置，只将唯一字面Host of-tunnel块的LocalForward改为127.0.0.1:listen_port到127.0.0.1:dest_port，并设置ExitOnForwardFailure yes、GatewayPorts no。端口必须严格整数1024–65535；非法端口或symlink配置抛ValueError且不修改。移除该目标块内旧转发/上述两个设置，幂等执行不能重复累加转发；保留该块的HostName/User/Port/IdentityFile和信任设置，其他Host及Host *原文与实际解析结果均不变。只能读写给定夹具文件，保持0600权限。验收实际调用ssh -G -F独立配置核对最终语义，不接受只写说明或全局配置。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实OpenSSH客户端-G解析验证，现有隔离Linux非root；只处理题面已知Host块结构，不支持任意Include/Match exec或复杂多模式重写。不建立SSH连接、不启动sshd、不声称隧道可达或远端服务健康；ExitOnForwardFailure不保证隧道后的应用目标可达。不修改宿主默认身份、信任库或SSH配置。
rubric: 核心概念与因果关系准确
前提、限制和验证方式与题意一致

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,os,pathlib,secrets,subprocess,sys,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd())
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
import task
def resolved(path,alias):
 result=subprocess.run(['ssh','-G','-F',str(path),alias],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=2)
 output={}
 for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
  key,_,value=line.partition(' ');output.setdefault(key,[]).append(value)
 return output
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-ssh-local-forward-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);config=root/'isolated config';protected=root/'keep';protected.write_bytes(b'KEEP\n')
 name='host-'+secrets.token_hex(6)+'.invalid'
 original=('Host of-tunnel\n  HostName '+name+'\n  User trainee\n  Port 2222\n  IdentityFile /private/keep-target-key\n  LocalForward 0.0.0.0:9000 127.0.0.1:9001\n  ExitOnForwardFailure no\n  GatewayPorts yes\nHost of-other\n  HostName other.invalid\n  User original-user\n  Port 2223\n  LocalForward 127.0.0.1:9100 127.0.0.1:9101\nHost *\n  CanonicalizeHostname no\n  StrictHostKeyChecking yes\n  UserKnownHostsFile /private/training-known-hosts\n  ForwardAgent no\n')
 config.write_text(original);config.chmod(0o600);before=resolved(config,'of-tunnel');other=resolved(config,'of-other');wild=resolved(config,'of-unmatched')
 def preserved_lines(text):
  result=[];active=False
  for line in text.splitlines(keepends=True):
   fields=line.split()
   if fields and fields[0].lower() in ('host','match'):active=line.strip()=='Host of-tunnel'
   if active and fields and fields[0].lower() in ('localforward','exitonforwardfailure','gatewayports'):continue
   result.append(line)
  return result
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:local forward loopback and destination through actual ssh -G',flush=True)
 for listen,dest in [(20000+secrets.randbelow(5000),30000+secrets.randbelow(5000)),(45001,45002)]:
  try:task.configure(config,listen,dest)
  except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('isolated SSH forward configuration failed') from error
  after=resolved(config,'of-tunnel')
  assert after['localforward']==[f'[127.0.0.1]:{listen} [127.0.0.1]:{dest}'],after['localforward']
  assert after['exitonforwardfailure']==['yes'] and after['gatewayports']==['no']
  assert {k:v for k,v in before.items() if k not in ('localforward','exitonforwardfailure','gatewayports')}=={k:v for k,v in after.items() if k not in ('localforward','exitonforwardfailure','gatewayports')},'target identity or trust changed'
  assert resolved(config,'of-other')==other and resolved(config,'of-unmatched')==wild,'unapproved alias/default changed'
  assert preserved_lines(config.read_text())==preserved_lines(original)
  saved=config.read_bytes();task.configure(config,listen,dest);assert config.read_bytes()==saved,'duplicate forward added on repeat'
  assert config.stat().st_mode&0o777==0o600 and protected.read_bytes()==b'KEEP\n'
 saved=config.read_bytes()
 for listen,dest in [(True,30000),(0,30000),(20000,65536),('20000',30000)]:
  try:task.configure(config,listen,dest)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('invalid port accepted')
 assert config.read_bytes()==saved
 link=root/'link';link.symlink_to(config)
 try:task.configure(link,20000,30000)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('symlink config accepted')
 assert config.read_bytes()==saved
 print('NATIVE_OPENSSH_G_LOCAL_FORWARD_LOOPBACK_DESTINATION_AND_OTHER_HOSTS_PRESERVED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
